title: Accessing OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock from Australia with global cross-Region inference
content: Australian teams can access OpenAI GPT-5.6 models (Sol, Terra, Luna) through Amazon Bedrock using global cross-Region inference from Sydney or Melbourne. Requests route automatically to supported commercial AWS Regions for processing. The models handle text and image inputs with up to 1 million token context windows. Developers can invoke them via Responses API, Chat Completions API, or Converse API. The article covers prompt caching, Codex setup with OIDC authentication, and monitoring through CloudWatch Coding Agent Insights.
